data.title: NMIMS vs Symbiosis: The Online MBA Battle You Cannot Miss
data.excerpt: For continuous growth and career advancement, an MBA has become essential for both students and working professionals. Simultaneously, choosing from top institutions like NMIMS (Narsee Monjee Institute of Management Studies) and Symbiosis SODL (Symbiosis School For Online and Digital Learning).
data.meta_description: Compare NMIMS and Symbiosis online MBA programs by fees, recognition, curriculum, flexibility and career support to choose the right option for you.
data.content_html:
For continuous growth and career advancement, an MBA has become essential for both students and working professionals. Simultaneously, choosing from top institutions like NMIMS (Narsee Monjee Institute of Management Studies) and Symbiosis SODL (Symbiosis School For Online and Digital Learning).

Both institutions are renowned for their academic excellence, but they have slight differences in their fee, placement, and other aspects. Read this blog till the end for a brief comparison of NMIMS vs Symbiosis online MBA courses.

College Name: Narsee Monjee Institute of Management Studies

Narsee Monjee Institute of Management Studies offers its online MBA course under its CDOE (Centre for Distance and Online Education) department. NMIMS CDOE boasts over 40 years of excellence in multidisciplinary education, featuring a distinguished faculty of academicians who nurture aspiring professionals through a KSA (Knowledge, Skill, Attitude) program structure.

College Name: Symbiosis Institute of Digital and Online Learning

The Symbiosis online MBA course is delivered under its dedicated department, SSODL (Symbiosis School of Online and Digital Learning). The institute holds 20 years of excellence and is known for the 51 legacy of Symbiosis. It provides students with learner-centric outcome-based education along with a contemporary curriculum and flexible learning.

Key Takeaways

Students stuck between choosing an online MBA from NMIMS vs Symbiosis are advised to consider the following key takeaways of both programs before making a decision.

NMIMS Online MBA

  • It offers 500+ active hiring partners and 20,000+ recruiters shaping students' careers.
  • 120+ faculty members from IIT and IIMs.
  • 82,000+ alumni across the world.
  • NMIMS online MBA includes a robust curriculum and practical learning to make students industry-ready.
  • Includes a dedicated student success team, allowing self-paced learning with e-learning resources.

Symbiosis Online MBA

  • The course follows and is delivered through a dynamic LMS (Learning Management System).
  • The learning pedagogy includes interdisciplinary and peer learning.
  • Symbiosis online MBA is a 100% online learning program.
  • Students are provided with 24*7 access to their LMS.
  • The course curriculum is developed by the top 10 Symbiosis Institutes in India.
  • For a better understanding, the course provides peer-to-peer doubt sharing and solving sessions.

Accreditations and Rankings

The accreditation and rankings are different for every university. Similarly, the NMIMS vs Symbiosis accreditation and rankings are listed below to assist in opting for the right course.

NMIMS Online MBA

  • Accredited with an “A++” grade by the National Assessment and Accreditation Council (NAAC).
  • Ranks #95 under the overall category, #52 under the university category, and #24 under the management category of the National Institutional Ranking Framework (NIRF).
  • Entitled by the University Grants Commission (UGC).

Symbiosis Online MBA

  • Accredited with an “A++” grade by the National Assessment and Accreditation Council (NAAC).
  • Ranks #24 under the university category, #40 under the overall category, and #11 under the management category of the National Institutional Ranking Framework (NIRF).
  • Approved by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE).
  • Entitled by the University Grants Commission (UGC).

Know Your Specialisations

The NMIMS vs Symbiosis online MBA courses are offered in multiple industry-oriented specializations. The different specializations available under each program are listed below.

NMIMS Online MBA

The NMIMS online MBA program offers the following specializations:

  • Marketing Management
  • Human Resource Management
  • Business Management
  • Financial Management
  • Operations and Data Sciences Management

Symbiosis Online MBA

The specializations available under the Symbiosis online MBA are as follows:

  • Marketing
  • Human Resource Management
  • Finance
  • Operations
  • Logistics & Supply Chain Management
  • Agri Operations Management
  • International Business
  • Business Analytics
  • Hospital and Health Care Management

Duration of the Course

The duration of an online MBA is 2 years, and it remains the same at every institution or university offering it.. However, to make it more convenient and accessible for working professionals and students with other responsibilities, some institutions extend the course validity. To know about the exact duration of online MBA in comparison to NMIMS vs Symbiosis, go through the pointers below.

NMIMS Online MBA

The NMIMS online MBA is a 2-year course that is offered with a validity of 4 years.

Symbiosis Online MBA

The Symbiosis online MBA course is a 24-month (2-year) course, and students are required to complete it within the prescribed time.

Cost Structure: Your Investment Explained

Pursuing an online MBA is a strategic investment for students and requires thorough research before making any decision. It helps students to maximize their ROI (Return on Investment) with better growth prospects. The entire fee structure of NMIMS vs Symbiosis online MBA is mentioned below.

NMIMS Online MBA

The NMIMS online MBA fee is INR 55,000 /- per semester. There are multiple payment options available, and every option has a different amount for the entire course fee. For a better understanding, go through the table below:

Fee PlanFee AmountFee Amount
Semester PlanINR 55,000 /- (4 semester)INR 2,20,000 /-
Annual PlanINR 1,05,000 /- (2 years)INR 2,10,000 /-
One-time payment planINR 1,96,000 /-INR 1,96,000 /-

Symbiosis Online MBA

The Symbiosis online MBA fee is INR 3,15,000 /- for the entire 2-year course. Students are provided with installment options that allow them to pay their course fees more conveniently.

Are You Eligible? Let’s Find Out!

The eligibility criteria for an online MBA course are almost similar at every university, but there are some slight differences. The complete details of the NMIMS vs Symbiosis online MBA eligibility criteria are mentioned below.

NMIMS Online MBA Eligibility Criteria

The NMIMS online MBA eligibility criteria are listed below:

  • A valid bachelor’s degree in any discipline from a recognized university.
  • A minimum of 50% of aggregate marks at graduation is mandatory.

Symbiosis Online MBA Eligibility Criteria

The eligibility criteria for the Symbiosis online MBA are as follows:

  • An undergraduate degree from a recognized university.
  • At least 50% of aggregate marks at graduation is mandatory.

Fee Concession and Scholarship Policy

To make higher education affordable for every student, NMIMS Online and Symbiosis Online offer several fee concessions and scholarship policies. It assists students with financial constraints in managing their finances.

NMIMS Online MBA

NMIMS online MBA offers various payment options with a different fee structure to assist students in managing their financial difficulties. Students can opt for a no-cost EMI plan starting from INR 8,750 /-, ranging from 3 to 24 months. The NMIMS online MBA no-cost EMI can be availed from the following banks:

  • HDFC Bank
  • ICICI Bank
  • Axis Bank
  • Citi Bank
  • Standard Chartered Bank
  • HSBC Bank
  • Kotak Mahindra Bank

NMIMS online MBA also offers scholarships of 20% for the armed forces, Defence Personnel, and their immediate family.

Symbiosis Online MBA

The Symbiosis online MBA offers EMI and a one-time payment concession of INR 50,000 /- on the overall course fee.

The Symbiosis online MBA EMI fee plan is mentioned below:

SemesterFee TypeFee Amount
Semester I1st InstallmentINR 10,000 /-
Semester I2nd InstallmentINR 80,000 /-
Semester II3rd InstallmentINR 80,000 /-
Semester III4th InstallmentINR 72,500 /-
Semester IV5th InstallmentINR 72,500 /-
Total course feeTotal course feeINR 3,15,000 /-

Career Services You Can Avail

To ensure better employment opportunities for students pursuing an online MBA from NMIMS and Symbiosis Online, they provide personalized career services.

NMIMS Online MBA

The career services available under the NMIMS online MBA course are as follows:

  • Profile development
  • Practice interview
  • Job portal
  • Coaching for career change

Symbiosis Online MBA

The Symbiosis online MBA placement and career services include:

  • CV writing
  • Interview skills
  • Aptitude tests

What Sets These Colleges Apart?

There are multiple unique key offerings under the online MBA course at NMIMS and Symbiosis online, which set them apart from each other.

NMIMS Online MBA Programme USPs

The NMIMS online MBA programme's USPs are mentioned below:

  • Highly acclaimed career-led program.
  • Integrated industry and academic best practices.
  • The program is considered and viewed by top employers.
  • Offers a 25% salary increase.

Symbiosis University Programme USPs

The Symbiosis University online MBA USPs are as follows:

  • Includes online assessments as per UGC guidelines.
  • Live teacher-student lectures and interactions.
  • The course includes 95 instructors and 22 unique programs.
  • Provide industry connections through guest sessions.
  • For better time management and work-life balance, the course conducts weekend sessions from 9.00 am to 5.00 pm.

The Final Analysis

When comparing NMIMS vs Symbiosis Online MBA, the decision relies on your priorities and requirements:

Go after the NMIMS Online MBA if you prefer:

  • A robust digital-first learning approach.
  • Industry connection through extensive live sessions.
  • A degree equivalent to a full-time MBA.

Choose Symbiosis Online MBA if you want:

  • A globally renowned MBA degree.
  • Flexible self-paced learning with print + digital learning materials.
  • More focus on practical learning with live interaction.

Both institutes are distinguished providers, and the decision should be guided by budget, learning style, and career plans.

Frequently Asked Questions

  • What are the main differences between NMIMS Global and Symbiosis (SSODL)?
  • Both universities offer an online MBA at par with an on-campus MBA degree, but their fee structure and course delivery methodology differ between NMIMS Global and Symbiosis (SSODL).
  • Which university has better approvals and recognition – NMIMS or Symbiosis?
  • Symbiosis has better approval and recognition than NMIMS CDOE.
  • Who offers better placement support for MBA students: NMIMS or Symbiosis?
  • NMIMS provides dedicated placement support and career services.
  • Which institute provides more specializations and flexible learning options?
  • Symbiosis provides more specializations and flexible learning options.
  • Which has stronger alumni support and industry connections?
  • Symbiosis has 12Lac+ strong alumni network, whereas NMIMS CDOE has 82K alumni across the world.
